desc: Read the input values: N, X, arrays A, B, P, Q.
Build two permutation graphs (implicitly via arrays P and Q).
For each permutation, determine the cycle containing X. Mark all nodes in that cycle as "can reach X".
For each box `i` from 1 to N:
If box `i` has red balls (A[i] > 0), check if `i` is in the same red-cycle as X. If not, return -1.
If box `i` has blue balls (B[i] > 0), check if `i` is in the same blue-cycle as X. If not, return -1.
Count the number of boxes that have at least one ball (A[i] > 0 or B[i] > 0). This is the answer.
